chunks: Ibn Muskan, from Ya‘qub ibn Salim al-Bazzaz, who said:
Abu ‘Abd Allah عليه السلام said: Pray them after al-Fajr.
And recite in them, in the first [rak‘ah]:

key_terms.أَحَدٌ: One; referring here to Allah’s oneness in Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ
key_terms.ٱقْرَأْ: recite; an instruction to recite specific surahs in the prayer
key_terms.ٱلثَّانِيَةِ: the second; meaning the second rak‘ah
key_terms.ٱلْأُولَىٰ: the first; meaning the first rak‘ah
key_terms.ٱلْفَجْرِ: al-Fajr; the dawn prayer/time mentioned as the point after which these two rak‘ahs are prayed
key_terms.ٱلْكَافِرُونَ: the disbelievers; referring to Sūrat al-Kāfirūn

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in the two rak‘ahs of al-Fajr according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding the two rak‘ahs of al-Fajr, specifying that they are to be prayed after al-Fajr and prescribing what should be recited in each rak‘ah. It directs the recitation of Sūrat al-Kāfirūn in the first rak‘ah and Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ in the second, highlighting a transmitted devotional practice in prayer.
